name: Ras Malai
description: Soft chenna cheese discs soaked in chilled saffron and cardamom-scented reduced milk for a luxurious dessert.
ingredients: a generous handful of fresh spinach
a handful of fresh curry leaves, chopped
instructions: Preheat your oven (or set up your steamer or frying station) and lightly grease your pan or molds with ghee.
In a large bowl, whisk together the roti and ground coriander until evenly combined.
In a separate bowl, blend the lemon wedges with the whole milk until smooth and well incorporated.
Gently fold the wet mixture into the dry ingredients, taking care not to overmix.
Transfer everything to your prepared pan or molds and cook — bake, steam, chill, or fry — until set, about 40 mins.
Remove from the heat and let it cool completely; this helps the texture firm up perfectly.
tips: Bring your lemon wedges to room temperature before mixing for a smoother, more even texture.
For the cleanest slices, chill the finished dessert thoroughly before cutting.
